setup.noToken: Please open the setup window from the program (double-click the icon), not directly in the browser.

s1.title: Welcome
s1.lead: In a few minutes, your viewers will be able to affect your gameplay with channel points. Here's what's already in place:
s1.winNoD: The key effects only work on Windows. You can still set up and test in simulation mode.
s1.ahkSoonT: Key control not set up yet
s1.ahkSoonD: AutoHotkey v2 will be installed in step 4.
s1.cs2NoD: You can enter it yourself in step 4.
s1.twNoD: We'll take care of that in steps 2 and 3.
s1.consentText: ChaosCore reliably executes every action you set up, for any game. ChaosCore cannot rule out an anti-cheat system reacting to that (a ban) — some games (e.g. CS2) are a lot more relaxed about it than others.
s1.consentRisk: Use is at your own risk.

s2.title: Twitch application
s2.lead: For the program to log in to Twitch, you need your own, free Twitch application. This takes about two minutes and is only needed once.
s2.guide1: Open the Twitch developer site and log in (Twitch requires two-factor authentication for this).
s2.guide6: Click "Create", then "Manage" on your app and copy the Client ID.
s2.streamKeyHint: You don't need your stream key here. Never enter it anywhere.
s2.cidStreamKey: That looks like a STREAM KEY! Don't enter that. You need the Client ID of your Twitch application.
s2.cidLen: A Client ID is exactly 30 characters (letters and digits).
s2.cidSavedHint: (to change it, just paste a new one)

s3.title: Log in to Twitch
s3.idleLead: Log in with your channel's own Twitch account (not an alt account). You'll only be granting: read and manage channel point redemptions.
s3.waitLead: Open Twitch and confirm the code. This window will notice right away.
s3.waitHint: On the Twitch page: enter the code (if asked) and click "Authorize".
s3.waiting: Waiting for your confirmation … (code still valid for
s3.readyForPointsNoAffiliate: Channel points and Bits are ready to go right away - Twitch doesn't require Affiliate or Partner status for either.
s3.codeExpired: The code has expired. Just start the login again.

s4.title: Game and controls
s4.lead: Here we connect CS2 to the program. Most values are already detected.
s4.sensHint: In the CS2 console: sensitivity. Determines how far "UNKNOWN spots you" looks up.
s4.ahkOkD: Effects are sent to the game as real key presses.
s4.ahkMissingD: Without AutoHotkey, effects only run as a simulation.
s4.winOnlyD: Everything here runs in simulation mode (for testing).
s4.dirNotFound: Not found automatically. Paste the path to the cfg folder.
s4.filesCurrent: The CS2 files are installed and up to date.
s4.filesStale: The CS2 files are outdated. Saving will update them.
s4.ahkInstalling: Installing AutoHotkey … (this can take a minute)
s4.filesInstalled: CS2 files installed. Restart CS2 (or type into the console: exec unknown_chat_control).
s4.dirMissing: CS2 folder missing: the files were not installed. Enter the cfg folder and save again.

s5.title: Rewards on Twitch
s5.lead: The program creates these rewards on your channel. You can adjust prices and cooldowns later in the dashboard and in data/actions.json.
s5.legacyHint: Did you create rewards like these by hand on Twitch before? No problem - matching existing rewards are now adopted automatically instead of creating duplicates.
s5.unmatchedSummary: Other rewards on your channel (not matching any action here)
s5.unmatchedHint: These rewards already exist on Twitch but don't belong to any action in this list - e.g. leftovers from an earlier test. You can clean them up here if you like.
s5.someFailed: Some rewards couldn't be created. Fix that and click again.

s6.title: Almost done
s6.obsHint: Add source → Browser → paste this address, width 1920, height 1080:
s6.scAutoSmall: ChaosCore then runs in the background without opening a window.
s6.runningLead: ChaosCore is running. You can check everything again here.
s6.lastCheckLead: One last check, then you're good to go.
s6.restarting: Restarting … this window will close, a new one will open shortly.

dash.panicTitle: Stops all effects, refunds the queue, and pauses
dash.quitTitle: Fully quits the program, including the overlay
dash.hotkeyNone: The hotkey is only active with AutoHotkey.
dash.reduceFlashWarning: Note: some effects flash/flicker quickly and can be a risk for photosensitivity (e.g. epilepsy). This option reduces that significantly, but doesn't replace your own caution.
dash.ovSaved: Saved. The overlay in OBS picks it up right away.
dash.dryExplain: "Dry" only shows the overlay. "Real" sends keys into the game (5 s lead time, CS2 must be in the foreground). Every change here (on/off, new, deleted) is synced with Twitch automatically right away.
dash.noEffectOption: — overlay message only, no game effect —
dash.templateExplain: Takes over the effect of an existing action (e.g. movement lock) under its own title/price/tier — handy for a pricier "VIP" version of the same effect.
dash.useBuilder: Build your own effect instead (instead of a template)
dash.seqHint: With no steps added, only the one effect configured above is created. With several steps, they run one after another in this order ("Advanced" mode, ROADMAP_1.0.md step 3a).
dash.builtinRewardsHint: Built-in rewards can be toggled on/off and have their price changed above, but not deleted.
dash.bitsExplain: Your own tiers for Twitch Bits cheers, separate from the channel-point rewards above - like channel points, Bits work on any channel, no Affiliate or Partner needed. Whoever cheers at least this much triggers the highest matching tier (no multiple triggers per cheer). Needs the "bits:read" scope — if you logged in a while ago, click "⚙ Setup" above and sign in again once.
dash.bitsTemplateExplain: Takes over the effect of an existing Bits tier under its own title/threshold — handy for an even stronger tier at very high cheers.
dash.fillTitleBits: Fill in title and Bits threshold.
dash.builtinBitsHint: Built-in Bits tiers can be toggled on/off and have their threshold changed above, but not deleted.
dash.avgWait: Avg. queue wait time (14 days): {s} s
dash.onboardingSummary: Getting started & what ChaosCore can do
dash.onboardingIntro: ChaosCore lets your viewers reach directly into the game with channel points and bits - with a lot more depth than the first setup shows:
dash.onboardingFeatAction: Own action builder: click together new effects without any code.
dash.onboardingFeatPreset: Share or back up presets: keys, actions and overlay look as one file.
dash.onboardingFeatGoal: Community goal: a shared progress bar for your chat.
dash.onboardingFeatSeason: Season & chaos score: an ongoing leaderboard across multiple streams.
dash.onboardingFeatQueue: Queue policy: how many effects can wait at once.
dash.onboardingFeatStats: Session stats: kills, deaths and who took you out with an effect.
dash.diagHint: If something's wrong: "Create error report" bundles the log, system status and current settings (no credentials) into a file to send along.
dash.connLost: Lost connection to the program. Is it still running? If this keeps happening, use "Create error report" below.
dash.apiFailGeneric: Unknown error ({code}). If this keeps happening, use "Create error report".
dash.selftestHint: Profile self-test: checks every configured action of the active game profile against your key bindings (without actually sending keys) — catches typos before a viewer triggers them.
dash.selftestNone: No actions configured for this profile.
dash.profileExplain: Save your keys, overlay look (incl. a custom sound/image) and custom rewards as one file, or hand them to another streamer. Every import shows a preview first. Contract goal, queue and personal game values are only applied if you tick them; focus check, window name and emergency-stop hotkey never are. Twitch login and server settings are never included.
dash.oneClickExplain: Built-in, vetted presets ready to apply directly without hunting for a file first (replaces your own rewards/keys/overlay look for that game).
dash.oneClickConfirm: Apply preset "{name}"? This replaces your own rewards/keys/overlay look.
dash.assetsHeading: Custom sound & image in the overlay
dash.assetsExplain: Replaces the default alert sound with your own (MP3/WAV/OGG, max. 900 KB), or shows your logo/image (PNG/JPG/GIF/WebP, max. 900 KB) at the top of the overlay. Both are embedded when you share a preset.
dash.goalExplain: A freely named goal with one or more thresholds - each is reached in turn, then it starts over. Each threshold can trigger a fixed action, or (left unset) a random one from the enabled pool, like the previous "Chaos Overload".
dash.idleExplain: If no one triggers anything for a while, ChaosCore can optionally trigger a harmless action from your own, limited selection by itself - clearly labeled as "ChaosCore", never as a viewer's name. A real redemption immediately resets the idle timer.
dash.idleModeAuto: Random from all enabled actions (simple, nothing to check)
dash.idleModeManual: Custom selection (only checked actions are eligible)
dash.idleWhitelist: Whitelist (only these actions are eligible - never the full pool):
dash.queueExplain: Effects with real keypresses always run one after another (otherwise they'd press each other's keys away) - pure overlay messages with no keypress always run immediately in parallel, regardless of this length. When the queue is full, you decide: refund instantly, or wait up to X seconds for a free slot.
dash.queueWaitSec: Wait time when queue is full, in seconds (0 = refund instantly)
dash.critExplain: Enter, Escape, Alt and similar keys can trigger a lot outside the game. Your own actions may only press them once you explicitly allow them here. Imported presets can never bring them along, and the Windows keys and combinations such as Alt+F4 always stay blocked.
dash.critPromptTitle: Critical keys in your key bindings
dash.critPromptExplain: Your key bindings use keys that can trigger a lot outside the game. Your bindings are kept either way. Should your actions still be allowed to press these keys? Until you answer, actions that need them stay switched off.
dash.critPromptLater: You can change this any time under System → "Critical keys".
dash.ipTitle: Preview: what this preset would do
dash.ipFieldQueueWait: Wait time when queue is full
dash.ipRejected: This preset will NOT be applied. Nothing was changed.
dash.ipValid: Checked: no invalid or blocked content found.
dash.ipGameSwitch: Note: switches the active game profile to "{name}".
dash.ipCritical: Uses critical keys from your own key bindings that you have already allowed: {keys}
dash.ipRemoved: Will be removed (not in the preset):
dash.ipOptional: Only with your consent (unticked keeps your own setting):
dash.ipNotImported: Never imported (stays as you have it):
dash.ipNotHold: wait time for the right game moment
dash.gsiRecExplain: Records the data the game sends to ChaosCore (for tests and troubleshooting Session Stats). The access token is never stored. The file stays on your PC. Stops by itself after 3 hours.
dash.stTimelineExplain: A death counts as "chaos" if it happens during a viewer effect or shortly after (time window adjustable below). Wrongly assigned? Just switch it.
dash.stTortureExplain: Who took you out with an effect most often this session.
dash.stAutoStream: Session starts and ends automatically with the stream
dash.stFailCommand: "!fail" in chat counts a fail (mods and you only)
dash.stAnnounce: Announce chaos deaths in chat (if the chat feature is on)
dash.stStreak: Announce kill streak from this many kills in one round (2-10)
dash.stModes: Don't count in these game modes (comma-separated, e.g. deathmatch)
dash.stViewing: You are viewing the session from {date}.
dash.stRunningSince: Running since {time} ({source}). Only counts during a session.
dash.stIdleAuto: Starts automatically when you go live - or start it manually now.
dash.stIdleManual: Automatic start is off - start the session manually.
dash.stNoAdapter: There's no automatic counting for this game yet - fails and manual counting work.
dash.stNoDeaths: No deaths yet - keep it up.
dash.stOverlayExplain: Shown in the overlay while a session is running. Position and size: "Overlay" section → layout (panel "Session Stats"). Separate OBS source with only the stats: overlay address with ?only=stats at the end.
dash.stOvPopups: Short pop-ups (chaos death, kill streak, fail)
dash.layoutVisibleHint: Which windows appear in the overlay. Switched-off windows disappear from OBS right away.
dash.miniToggleTitle: Switches to a small view with the queue and the most important buttons
dash.miniClearTitle: Clear the queue, everyone gets their points back
dash.miniEmpty: Queue is empty - waiting for the next redemption.
dash.miniClearConfirm: Click again to clear - everyone gets their points back.
dash.chatExplain: ChaosCore announces itself in chat and answers its own fixed commands - deliberately not a Nightbot-style rebuild (no moderation, no giveaways). If your Twitch login doesn't yet have chat permissions: click "⚙ Setup" above and sign in again once.
dash.chatAnnounceSeasonEndingSoon: Announce when the season is ending soon
dash.chatStatsNote: The built-in !chaosstats command is always available (once the chat feature is on) and shows the asking person's triggered actions, Chaos points and favorite effect - no other bot can know that.
dash.chatBeginnerExplain: A chat command is a fixed word that ChaosCore answers with a fixed reply in chat - e.g. someone types !discord and ChaosCore automatically replies with your invite link. There's already an example below: try the preview first, before the command goes live.
dash.chatPreviewHint: Just a preview - nothing was sent to the real chat yet. Use "+ Add command" below to go live.
dash.realConfirm: Send for real? Switch to the game within the next 5 seconds.
dash.deleteConfirm: Really delete "{title}"? It will also be removed on Twitch.
dash.quitConfirm:
Really quit the program?
All effects will stop and the overlay will go dark.
dash.quitDone: Quit. You can close this window now.
dash.restartDone: Restarting … the window will reload shortly.
dash.authFailedNote: The Twitch login is invalid. Click "⚙ Setup" above and sign in again.
dash.noRewardLinkedNote: No reward is linked to Twitch. Click "Sync rewards with Twitch" or "⚙ Setup" above.
dash.testVersionNote: Test version — not intended for live use (valid until {date}).
dash.noConnection: No connection to ChaosCore (is the program still running?).
dash.noToken: No valid access token. Open the dashboard via the link in the terminal.
dash.profileImportedActions: Preset imported, including your custom rewards. Now click "Sync rewards with Twitch".
dash.profileImportBadJson: That isn't a valid preset file (not JSON).
dash.layoutHint: Drag the boxes to the position you want, use the slider to adjust the size. Takes effect in the overlay right away.
dash.seasonEmpty: No participation in this season yet.
dash.seasonEndBtn: End season now & start a new one
dash.seasonEndConfirm: Really end the current season now? The leaderboard will be recorded as "last season" and reset to 0.
